How to verify: Use the exact hardware model's current drawing, template, load, and installation instructions.
Pass criteria: Dimensions and limits trace to the purchased model rather than a generic example.

How to verify: Measure panel, door, front, edge, gap, and finish build-up at the hardware interface.
Pass criteria: The hardware calculation uses real construction dimensions.

How to verify: Install one complete set on production-equivalent material and cycle it through full travel.
Pass criteria: Fit, adjustment, access, and appearance pass before batch drilling.

How to verify: Center initial settings where practical and record the remaining correction range.
Pass criteria: Installation can absorb expected variation without exceeding adjustment limits.

How to verify: Open, close, extend, retract, disconnect, latch, and adjust each moving item through its complete range.
Pass criteria: Operation is smooth and repeatable without collision.

How to verify: Test shelves, slides, pullouts, and lifts with a safe representative load permitted by the product.
Inspect seating, torque guidance, thread engagement, slots, cams, covers, and remaining adjustment.
Pass criteria: Hardware is secure and not parked at the end of its adjustment range.
